a.text: Vina, Hannah, Baird... we walk into the wind on the great avenue, our shirts hanging open in the wind.
The Originium lights never sleep. Norport's border checkpoints are like huge gaping mouths, churning through imports and exports.
Weighers' joints ache with tendonitis from overwork. The calluses on the shoulders of loaders grow thick and solid.
Norport will become Victoria's most prosperous borough.
Norport Borough will belong to the Glasgow Gang.
Whoever controls Norport controls Londinium, controls Victoria.

steps.name: Gangster A
steps.text: What's the coppers doing?

steps.name: Gangster B
steps.text: Dunno. We was occupied wif sendin' the boss to hospital.

steps.name: Gangster A
steps.text: What 'appened to the boss?

steps.name: Gangster B
steps.text: Crate ta the head. Knocked out cold straight up. Blood everywhere. A right picture that was.

steps.name: Gangster A
steps.text: Who started it?

steps.name: Gangster B
steps.text: Them! And I know they pushed the boss into that forklift on purpose!

steps.name: Gangster A
steps.text: Saints alive, those Sudean bastards is shittin' down our necks now that they've got sixpence to rub together!

steps.name: Gangster B
steps.text: We left us some boys there. Should get word if there's any news.

steps.name: Gangster B
steps.text: Any time now.

steps.name: Indra
steps.text: You really expect the coppers'll play fair?

steps.name: Morgan
steps.text: Hold it for a minute, Hannah, love.

steps.name: Gangster A
steps.text: Outsiders? Who let them in?

steps.name: Morgan
steps.text: Lane Brothers' Gang, right? We're here representin' the Glasgow Gang. We heard about Mr. Lane's injury and wanted to pay our respects.

steps.name: Gangster A
steps.text: Glasgow Gang... I've heard the name...

steps.name: Gangster A
steps.text: Thanks, anyways.

steps.name: Morgan
steps.text: (I told you he'd be in hospital, but you insisted on coming to their hideout.)

steps.name: Indra
steps.text: We'll do more good here than at the hospital. It's called 'in the hour of need.'

steps.name: Morgan
steps.text: (Keep it down!)

steps.name: Gangster Messenger
steps.text: *pant* Lemme catch my breath...

steps.name: Gangster B
steps.text: What's the word from the coppers?

steps.name: Gangster Messenger
steps.text: Locked up a few boys and said they're takin' the boss in for questioning once he's out of 'ospital.

steps.name: Gangster Messenger
steps.text: Word is they plan to crack down on Norport gangs causin' trouble for Sudean factories, and that any ringleaders would be punished severely.

steps.name: Gangster Messenger
steps.text: Well, somethin' like that.

steps.name: Gangster B
steps.text: What about the bastard who hurt the boss?

steps.name: Gangster Messenger
steps.text: Coppers let him off with a small fine.

steps.name: Gangster A
steps.text: Piece of shit brass-bollocking,

steps.name: Gangster A
steps.text: PC Plod wankfest parade of...

steps.name: Gangster A
steps.text: PC Plod wankfest parade of...

steps.name: Gangster A
steps.text: Ah, shit, I need the whole dictionary!

steps.name: Morgan
steps.text: Calm down.

steps.name: Indra
steps.text: I told you, ya can't count on the coppers.

steps.name: Indra
steps.text: I say we go into Sudean, find the son of a stockbeast who hurt Mr. Lane, and rip his bloody head off.

steps.name: Indra
steps.text: They've been tramplin' us for long enough! It's about time we got back at 'em!

steps.name: Gangster A
steps.text: She's right, our friend here from, er... Glasgow! Glasgow Gang!

steps.name: Gangster A
steps.text: Let's get 'em!

steps.name: Gangster
steps.text: We'll get 'em!

steps.name: Indra
steps.text: I'm comin' too!

steps.name: Morgan
steps.text: Hannah, love, Vina sent us to find Mr. Lane.

steps.name: Morgan
steps.text: Don't get mixed up in their business.

steps.name: Indra
steps.text: This is about all of Norport! We've all gotta step up!

steps.name: Indra
steps.text: Two more draught beers. Make 'em big.

steps.name: Morgan
steps.text: Don't drink too much, Hannah. There's a soapy taste to today's beer.

steps.name: Indra
steps.text: I knew you were addin' flavor capsules to it. Just didn't bother to call you out.

steps.name: Morgan
steps.text: Hehe...

steps.name: Indra
steps.text: Why'd you stop me?

steps.name: Morgan
steps.text: Hannah, you daft cat. You forgotten what happened at the cinema last week?

steps.name: Indra
steps.text: Yeah.

steps.name: Morgan
steps.text: The glassworkers were hogging up tapes and places at McClaren's video store. They got into a fight with our people, brought the coppers right in.

steps.name: Morgan
steps.text: But they went back to Sudean without losing a hair.

steps.name: Indra
steps.text: Makes me mad just thinkin' about it.

steps.name: Morgan
steps.text: The cops are taking their side even on our own turf. I'm not the slightest bit surprised at how they dealt with this.

steps.name: Indra
steps.text: That's why we need to get back at 'em. We can't count on the cops!

steps.name: Morgan
steps.text: Ai-yi-yi, no one's counting on the cops. Use your brain, love.

steps.name: Morgan
steps.text: This is a big deal. They did it this way on purpose, just waiting for somebody to make a move to give them an excuse to clean up.

steps.name: Morgan
steps.text: The real question is, why are the coppers taking sides?

steps.name: Morgan
steps.text: This ain't anything new. It's been happening for years.

steps.name: Indra
steps.text: Bloody 'ell, I got no idea.

steps.name: Tired Worker
steps.text: Two bowls of beer soup, Paul, nice and hot.

steps.name: Tired Worker
steps.text: Extra croutons on top.

steps.name: Depressed Worker
steps.text: I guess the envelope was too thin to catch the attention of those bigwigs at the Sudean Labor Office.

steps.name: Depressed Worker
steps.text: But that's already a year's savings...

steps.name: Tired Worker
steps.text: Don't think about it now. This one's on me.

steps.name: Depressed Worker
steps.text: Thanks...

steps.name: Depressed Worker
steps.text: Still need to look for a way to move to Sudean. Having to cross boroughs to go to work every day is rough...

steps.name: Tired Worker
steps.text: Sure 'nuff...

steps.name: Tired Worker
steps.text: Who would've thought ten years ago that people from Norport would be flocking to Sudean factories and docks?

steps.name: Depressed Worker
steps.text: Times change. When you're down, you're down.

steps.name: Depressed Worker
steps.text: We used to have the most depots in Londinium, and the biggest ones too. We were the door to the city. Ever since light industry in Sudean took off, though...

steps.name: Depressed Worker
steps.text: Textiles, glassware, cans, appliances... they just keep building factories and producing more stuff.

steps.name: Depressed Worker
steps.text: Then came the depots, and you could see Norport falling before your eyes.

steps.name: Depressed Worker
steps.text: Only two things keep growing on the streets: one, young people who've joined the gangs, spending their days at the cinemas, billiard clubs and bars.

steps.name: Depressed Worker
steps.text: The other, poorhouses, which barely scratch the surface of the problem. There are so many people living off unemployment aid in Norport, and Londinium wants no more to do with us.
Morgan thinks back to the page of Morgan's Memoirs that she tore off. Beer goes down, memories come up.
Trucks and carts loading and unloading, tailor shops and magazine stalls all over the streets, smiles everywhere.
Hotel bellboys on Sunset Street, so busy they hardly get a drink of water all day.
Merchants and high society from all over Victoria and as far away as Leithanien and Kazimierz, checking in one after another.
It was the face of Londinium.
How did it turn out like this?
Morgan gulps down the rest of her mug. Twenty years of Norport, two decades of her life, down the throat with the beer.

steps.name: Morgan
steps.text: Well, stuff me.

steps.name: Tired Worker
steps.text: Let's go. Early shift tomorrow.

steps.name: Depressed Worker
steps.text: I'm stopping by the Labor Office again tomorrow. You oughta come along, move to Sudean too, if you know what's good for you.

steps.name: Depressed Worker
steps.text: I know what you're thinking. I'll miss it too. But you never know when Londinium will decide to cast it away.

steps.name: Morgan
steps.text: You remember those two, Hannah?

steps.name: Morgan
steps.text: They used to be weighers on the docks. True blue Berties. People I looked up to when I was little...

steps.name: Indra
steps.text: If the Berties stopped caring about Norport, there might really come a day when Londinium casts Norport aside, as they said.

steps.name: Indra
steps.text: This is our fight.

steps.name: Morgan
steps.text: I never said it wasn't.

steps.name: Morgan
steps.text: Hannah, you daft cat, we both know you and me could go to Sudean right now, dig up whoever hurt Mr. Lane, beat him senseless, even put him in the ground.

steps.name: Morgan
steps.text: But a fight won't solve our problems.

steps.name: Morgan
steps.text: Don't worry, I've been thinking about it.

steps.name: Indra
steps.text: I hope you're right.
Two weeks later...

steps.name: Siege
steps.text: Why are you pacing in circles? Is the new sofa too hard for you?

steps.name: Indra
steps.text: You called us all here for a job. What is it? Are we gonna get back at them for what they did to Mr. Lane?

steps.name: Siege
steps.text: Slow down.

steps.name: Baird
steps.text: The Lane Brothers are through, Vina.

steps.name: Indra
steps.text: What?!

steps.name: Indra
steps.text: The man himself is still lying in a hospital bed, and they're just gonna give up? Throw away their hideout?

steps.name: Indra
steps.text: Weren't they all up in arms, ready to set fire to the other side's factories?

steps.name: Baird
steps.text: They got a bunch of people together a couple of times, but they were stopped before they could leave Norport. Things just fell apart after that.

steps.name: Baird
steps.text: The Sudean Labor Office recruited a new lot of workers from Norport this week. A few Lane Brothers heavies were on the list.

steps.name: Baird
steps.text: The Lane Brothers couldn't stay together without anyone running the show.

steps.name: Indra
steps.text: Those traitors!

steps.name: Siege
steps.text: We can't blame them.

steps.name: Siege
steps.text: The Lane Brothers used to watch over the biggest warehouses around here, collecting enough protection money to feed a few hundred mouths.

steps.name: Siege
steps.text: It's hard to keep up in the sorry state of Norport's markets today.

steps.name: Baird
steps.text: Everyone's here, Vina. They're waiting outside.

steps.name: Siege
steps.text: Alright, let's go.

steps.name: Indra
steps.text: Where to?

steps.name: Siege
steps.text: The Lane Brothers' hideout.

steps.name: Siege
steps.text: The Glasgow Gang will take in anyone from the Lane Brothers who has nowhere to go.

steps.name: Indra
steps.text: What're you on about?

steps.name: Baird
steps.text: Don't you get it, Hannah? We're taking over Lane Brothers territory.

steps.name: Indra
steps.text: That's like robbin' a man while his house is on fire!

steps.name: Siege
steps.text: I suppose you could put it like that.

steps.name: Indra
steps.text: Why are we doing this?

steps.name: Baird
steps.text: It's a long story; I'll explain on the way. Grab your stuff and we'll head out. There's a lot to do today.

steps.name: Baird
steps.text: Not just the Lane Brothers' warehouses; cinemas, billiard clubs, cafes, hotels... we're visiting half the establishments in Norport.

steps.name: Baird
steps.text: You'll have plenty of things to punch today.

steps.name: Indra
steps.text: Norport's gangs may not be all that big, but everyone sticks to their territory, and sticks together when there's trouble from outside.

steps.name: Indra
steps.text: That's why the other boroughs never tried to mess with us.

steps.name: Indra
steps.text: Vina's only been in Norport a few years. You and Morgan and me grew up here. How could we sign on to this?

steps.name: Indra
steps.text: Hey, where is Morgan? Does she know what we're doin'?

spans.text: Morgan? Does she know what we're doin'?

steps.name: Siege
steps.text: It's Morgan's plan, Hannah.

steps.name: Siege
steps.text: She's not with us today because she has her own job to do.

steps.name: Wary Man
steps.text: I'm here. I'm alone. Show yourself.

steps.name: Wary Man
steps.text: Who are you? Sneaking around like that, throwing letters tied to rocks... you broke my window, dammit.

steps.name: Wary Man
steps.text: And your writing's real ugly.

steps.name: Morgan
steps.text: Hah!

steps.name: Morgan
steps.text: My writing's ugly?

steps.name: Wary Man
steps.text: Hey, what's with the machete?!

steps.name: Wary Man
steps.text: No funny stuff, I'm warning you. Lots of boys around here. All I need to do is shout.

steps.name: Morgan
steps.text: Go on, shout. You read my letter.

steps.name: Wary Man
steps.text: Why you...

steps.name: Morgan
steps.text: You should be glad it's me here and not my friends. I came to talk. This is only for when talking goes wrong.

steps.name: Morgan
steps.text: Bernie from Romi Textiles in Sudean Borough, am I right? Just double-checking.

steps.name: Wary Man
steps.text: The stuff in the envelope. How did you find out?

steps.name: Morgan
steps.text: The unstamped lists of goods and invoices with your name on it?

steps.name: Morgan
steps.text: It wasn't hard. Took me just two weeks to put together all you did this past year.

steps.name: Morgan
steps.text: Pirated videos, unprocessed spices, Arts generators, Originium equipment... all controlled goods in Sudean that you sneaked through the checkpoints.

steps.name: Morgan
steps.text: What would Mr. Romi do if he found out his foreman has been runnin' a smuggling hustle through his factory?

steps.name: Morgan
steps.text: Would he break your legs, or hand you over to the coppers so they can do it?

steps.name: Wary Smuggler
steps.text: What do you want?

steps.name: Morgan
steps.text: Remember Mr. Lane? You got into a fight with him here two weeks ago. Sent him to the hospital.

steps.name: Morgan
steps.text: He's still there. I think you owe him an apology, and his medical bills too. Not a pence short.

steps.name: Wary Smuggler
steps.text: Oh, so it's the Lane Brothers. Took you two weeks to do something, did it?

steps.name: Wary Smuggler
steps.text: Wait a minute, I thought you were wound up.

steps.name: Morgan
steps.text: The Lane Brothers' Gang is no more.

steps.name: Morgan
steps.text: I'm Morgan. Morgan of the Glasgow Gang.

steps.name: Morgan
steps.text: Remember the name. This won't be the last time we do business.

steps.name: Wary Smuggler
steps.text: Pah, what business could we possibly have with Norport?

steps.name: Wary Smuggler
steps.text: Look at that train behind you, girl. A dozen carriages, carrying more in a day than your old docks see in a week.

steps.name: Wary Smuggler
steps.text: Look at all those elevators and carts working around the clock, and rows of factories stretching as far as the eye can see. You got those in Norport?

steps.name: Wary Smuggler
steps.text: Tell you what. I'll find you a job on the line, and you give me the originals of what was in that envelope. How's that for a deal?

steps.name: Wary Smuggler
steps.text: What are you doing?
The 'brain' of the Glasgow Gang walks up to the man, smiling, and buries her fist in his belly.
The man falls to his knees, grabbing his stomach, his face twisted in pain.
He looks up to see the young Feline glaring down at him. Her face is pretty; her expression, less so.

steps.name: Wary Smuggler
steps.text: Gah...

steps.name: Wary Smuggler
steps.text: Got distracted by the machete...

steps.name: Morgan
steps.text: For all that Sudean has, you smuggled all this stuff through Norport, taking the long way round.

steps.name: Morgan
steps.text: Sudean's checkpoints are pretty strict, aren't they? Isn't it interesting how certain things only get into Londinium through the old depots?

steps.name: Morgan
steps.text: The gangs of Norport have been struggling to stay afloat for a couple of years. Starting today, though, the Glasgow Gang runs the show in Norport. All of it.

steps.name: Morgan
steps.text: You want to keep your hustle, you keep your tail firmly between your legs.

steps.name: Morgan
steps.text: You can go now. You can guess what happens if you don't show up at the hospital before the sun sets.

steps.name: Morgan
steps.text: A word of advice. People like you and I, trying to get on top of one another? There's no point to any of it.

steps.name: Morgan
steps.text: Yes, Sudean is booming right now. Lots of smokestacks, lots of workers. You're drawing a lot of envy.

steps.name: Morgan
steps.text: But have you ever set foot in Auchterigg?

steps.name: Morgan
steps.text: Have you seen the nobles' mansions? Alleys wider than a central avenue in Sudean?

steps.name: Morgan
steps.text: Their clothes are always sparkling clean. They don't punch their timecards for the morning shift, and they don't watch pirated video tapes when they get off in the evening. They drink tea in gardens bigger than any of the factories behind you.

steps.name: Morgan
steps.text: Sudean, Norport? It's all the same to them.

steps.name: Morgan
steps.text: Who knows if Sudean won't become the next Norport? Maybe a new industry rises in another borough in a few years to take your place.

steps.name: Morgan
steps.text: We're all the same to Londinium, Bernie. They can throw us out at any time.

steps.name: Morgan
steps.text: We can't keep up with the changing times.

steps.name: Morgan
steps.text: I'm back.

steps.name: Baird
steps.text: Is everything fine, Morgan?

steps.name: Morgan
steps.text: Of course I'm fine. Bernie, not so much. He should be in Mr. Lane's ward as we speak.

steps.name: Morgan
steps.text: Too bad none of you were there to watch the showdown between Kate Morrigan and Sudean's throng of smugglers.

steps.name: Morgan
steps.text: Well, I'll be sure to write it down in my memoirs for you to enjoy.

steps.name: Indra
steps.text: Oh, please, gimme a break.

steps.name: Baird
steps.text: Hahahaha...

steps.name: Morgan
steps.text: What have you been up to?

steps.name: Baird
steps.text: Took in a dozen lads from the Lane Brothers who accepted Vina as their new boss. You'll be able to write while watching the warehouses from now on.

steps.name: Siege
steps.text: We visited seven gangs today. Talked three into joining. Hannah and I beat the other four into submission.

steps.name: Siege
steps.text: But the markets of Norport are barren, and the gangs living off it a bunch of loose rabble. It's a disorganized mess, not something that you can just bring together in the blink of an eye.

steps.name: Morgan
steps.text: No hurry. The Glasgow Gang is in this for the long haul.

steps.name: Morgan
steps.text: Thanks for agreeing to it, Vina.

steps.name: Morgan
steps.text: I've always wanted to ask you... who does Londinium belong to?

steps.name: Morgan
steps.text: One or two boroughs more or less won't make much of a difference to Londinium. Who are we, then? What are we?

steps.name: Morgan
steps.text: Could Londinium actually cast Norport away?

steps.name: Siege
steps.text: I don't know the answer, Morgan. I'm still looking for it, myself... for Londinium, and for Victoria.

steps.name: Siege
steps.text: But I'm part of the Glasgow Gang, which makes me part of Norport.

steps.name: Siege
steps.text: I can't make any promises, but I won't stand idly by, if the day comes.

steps.name: Baird
steps.text: No need to promise us anything.

steps.name: Baird
steps.text: We're not afraid, as long as we stick together.

steps.name: Indra
steps.text: Exactly! Let's see the fat cats of Central Londinium try. I'll kick down the doors of their mansions and punch 'em square in the face.

steps.name: Baird
steps.text: I'll pour boiling coffee on their evening dresses.

steps.name: Siege
steps.text: I'll take care of the arson.

steps.name: Indra
steps.text: What about you, Morgan?

steps.name: Morgan
steps.text: Don't worry, I won't stop you, if it comes to that.

steps.name: Morgan
steps.text: You're right. No need to overthink.

steps.name: Morgan
steps.text: We're not the nobles. We can't build a big project to revitalize a borough in decline, or run some policies to help the people who live here.

steps.name: Baird
steps.text: But there are things the people of Norport can do for themselves.

steps.name: Indra
steps.text: Sure enough.

steps.name: Indra
steps.text: So why didn't you tell your plan earlier, Morgan?

steps.name: Morgan
steps.text: Hannah, you daft cat, did you really think those muscles in your brain would understand?
